text_c9fa26ef1765: Start station / reporting point (DS100 or name)
text_60ee27e69534: Choose the starting point by DS100 or name. Click M1 operating points in route order. Where several VzG lines are possible, choose the correct section. Zoom with + and − and drag to pan. Only Save records your selection as qualified route knowledge. Confirmed imports retain priority. Click consecutive operating points (up to 1,001 per selection). The map stays in place as you continue clicking; drag it when needed. Your existing imported, manual and GPS route knowledge appears in its existing colours. Your new selection is a continuous light-green line with a light outline above that inventory. Only Save records the new route. From zoom level 11, VzG route numbers appear in red with a thin black outline on a light background. Labels avoid overlap and keep operating points clickable. They remain hidden in the Germany overview. Berlin and Hamburg S-Bahn reference routes and S-Bahn-only operating points are hidden. Parallel mainline and freight routes remain visible. Your stored knowledge and GPS recordings are not deleted. The Undo icon at the top left of the manual map removes the last point and section with each click. Below the map, the current selection shows DS100, station/reporting point, route number and M1 mileage. Continue drawing from here removes only later selection points. Saving clears this selection list. The saved route remains below with From, To and Valid until in DD.MM.YYYY format. Click it to edit it in the map and list. Save changes updates the same record; Cancel editing leaves the saved state unchanged. A failed save retains your selection.

text_e9adb0ccdb32: Junctions only hides intermediate points without removing your selected points or drawn sections. Junctions are derived from connected M1 operating points. Turn the filter off to select intermediate or end points. Light-green location pins mark your selection; light-blue pins and lines suggest the next connected points and sections. Suggestions are not selected yet. All lines at once is offered only when every candidate VzG section runs parallel between the selected points according to M1 geometry (at most 200 metres apart, checked along the sections as well as at endpoints). Saving includes every selected parallel section; editing preserves the multiple selection. Undo sits on a transparent background at the top left of the map.
